p.s: People have different opinions whether traveling with group and guide is good way or not.
I strongly believe that travel is in a group with tour guide is more beneficial because we can save time and money and also that is safety.
Let me explain for supporting my opinions.
First of all, traveling with tour guide who is already know about travel place allow us to save time and money.
Even though some people worry about tight schedule of group tour, I think that economical advantage is eclipse the weak point.
For example, suppose that you travel around where you have never been before, you might be lost road and you do n't know where is best place for traveling.
So you need to solve the problems.
Considering limit time on unknown place, all of things you face with problems is waste of time and money.
If you travel with tour guide, you could less the heavy problems and you could save time and money because guide will lead where they already know and where is best place for travel.
Next, travel with group and guide allow us to safety.
Although that is unappealing when it comes to challenging aspects, in strange area, the most important thing is safety.
For example, If I go to where I have never been before, there are possibilities to be exposed to dangerous things.
Without assistance of tour guide, I could not avoide that.
In addition, as I include in group, I feel more comfortable and stable because there is less chance to be a suspects ' target.
If I really want to challenge in other countries, I would like to travel where I have already been.
Therefore, as far as I concerned, keeping my self is the prioty thing for traveling.
In conclusion, I prefer to travel with others because of saving time and money, and also I am worried about my safety.
Moreover, in circustance under safety, I can really enjoy for traveling.
